declared difference (truth fix T2): the bash awk read @NiagaraType, `extends B<Upper>` and `class <Name>` in the
comment-blanked text, where string literals are still text, so a pure class quoting "@NiagaraType" or
"extends BFoo" lost its method rule (Quote, Ext) and a literal "class Lit" named the file (Named). They are
read in code only now (literal contents blanked).
